data.headline: AI is reshaping software development
data.subheadline: GitHub Copilot now writes 40% of all code commits

data.context: GitHub reports that Copilot now generates 40% of all code in files where it's enabled
data.takeaway: AI pair programming is becoming the norm, not the exception

data.title: What This Means for Developers
data.body: AI coding assistants are shifting the role of developers from writing every line to reviewing and directing AI-generated code. The skill gap is widening between those who adapt and those who don't.

data.callToAction: Are you using AI to code yet?
data.subtext: Share your experience in the comments

manifest.caption:
AI is now writing 40% of code on GitHub.

That's not a prediction.

It's happening right now.

Developers who embrace AI assistants are 10x more productive.

Are you adapting?

sourceArticle.title: GitHub Copilot is now writing 40% of code
sourceArticle.description: New data shows AI pair programming is rapidly becoming mainstream in software development
